column1: # No price and no distributor. A library is technical; what a part costs is
# answered by a different system. See doqs/docs/decisions/2026-09-18_money-out-of-the-bom.md.
# `cad` and `datasheet` may be empty: the table is the complete catalogue and
# the files are a cache that fills as people use parts.
#   redistributable  the brand's terms or a written permission allow sharing
#                    and the brand's okh.toml records a public [[terms-review]]
#   fetch-only       the file is not committed; each person downloads it
#   private          the file is not committed and has no public address; the
#                    only copy is in the private library
#   own-model        `cad` is our own model under cad/own/
# `status` is eol for a part you can no longer buy. Never delete the row: an
# existing machine is still made of it.
